Title: General availability: Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server with AMD compute

Body.Content:
You can now choose between Intel and AMD hardware for your instances of Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server based on the general purpose (Dadsv5-series) and business critical (Eadsv5-series) tiers. To ensure transparency when working in the portal, you can select the compute hardware vendor for both primary and secondary server. After you determine the best compute processor for your workload, deploy your instances of Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server in an increased number of availability regions and zones.

Learn more.
